acceptanceCriteria: the cause of TestObservedDescendantCancellationReapsEscapedChild failing under -race on a loaded host is identified and retained in a build-log entry (test timing assumption vs product defect)
the test passes -race -count=20 under synthetic CPU contention (load around 40-60 on 12 CPUs) without widening a product bound silently; a real reap failure still fails it
body: Observed by the V1-1368 lane (PR #891, 2026-10-14, darwin 12 CPUs, go1.27.2): internal/procgroup TestObservedDescendantCancellationReapsEscapedChild failed 4/10 under -race at BASE 92c298a6e and 4/10 with the V1-1368 change (unchanged rate, so pre-existing and not caused by the ps-snapshot bound). Passed when rerun alone. Same timing-under-load class as V1-1343, V1-1362 and V1-1324. Suspected test flake; not yet confirmed whether reaping itself can be late.
title: TestObservedDescendantCancellationReapsEscapedChild fails 4/10 under -race on a loaded host
